mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_evaluation ( resume_id, dispatch_id, candidate_name, candidate_gender, work_years, applied_level, supplier_name, interviewer_id, interviewer_name, interviewer_department, platform, entry_level_suggestion, score, interview_method, interview_date, hire_suggestion, attachment_name, attachment_url, approval_status, current_approval_level, create_time, create_user_id, create_user_name, update_time, update_user_id, update_user_name ) VALUES ( #{resumeId}, #{dispatchId}, #{candidateName}, #{candidateGender}, #{workYears}, #{appliedLevel}, #{supplierName}, #{interviewerId}, #{interviewerName}, #{interviewerDepartment}, #{platform}, #{entryLevelSuggestion}, #{score}, #{interviewMethod}, #{interviewDate}, #{hireSuggestion}, #{attachmentName}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{approvalStatus}, #{currentApprovalLevel}, #{createTime}, #{createUserId}, #{createUserName}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUserId}, #{updateUserName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_evaluation SET resume_id = #{resumeId}, dispatch_id = #{dispatchId}, candidate_name = #{candidateName}, candidate_gender = #{candidateGender}, work_years = #{workYears}, applied_level = #{appliedLevel}, supplier_name = #{supplierName}, interviewer_id = #{interviewerId}, interviewer_name = #{interviewerName}, interviewer_department = #{interviewerDepartment}, platform = #{platform}, entry_level_suggestion = #{entryLevelSuggestion}, score = #{score}, interview_method = #{interviewMethod}, interview_date = #{interviewDate}, hire_suggestion = #{hireSuggestion}, attachment_name = #{attachmentName}, attachment_url = #{attachmentUrl}, approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, current_approval_level = #{currentApprovalLevel}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_user_name = #{updateUserName} WHERE evaluation_id = #{evaluationId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM interview_evaluation WHERE resume_id = #{resumeId} ORDER BY update_time DESC, evaluation_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM interview_evaluation ORDER BY update_time DESC, evaluation_id DESC
SELECT * FROM interview_evaluation WHERE create_user_id = #{createUserId} ORDER BY update_time DESC, evaluation_id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ie.* FROM interview_evaluation ie INNER JOIN interview_evaluation_approval_history h ON h.evaluation_id = ie.evaluation_id WHERE h.approver_id = #{approverId} ORDER BY ie.update_time DESC, ie.evaluation_id DESC
